$comment: THE ONE PLACE THE PUBLISHING SCOPE AND REGISTRY ARE SET. Change `scope` here, then run `node scripts/set-scope.mjs` to propagate it to every package.json name, every import in docs and source comments, and the workspace README; `node scripts/set-scope.mjs --check` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:scope`) fails if any package name drifts from it. Change `registry` here, then run `node scripts/set-registry.mjs` to propagate it to every package.json's `publishConfig.registry`; `node scripts/set-registry.mjs --check` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:registry`) fails if any package's declared registry drifts from it. Nothing else in this repository should hardcode a scope or a registry.
status: GitHub Packages is Foundry's canonical registry. Foundry is the only repository under this owner authorized to publish packages; private account-control-plane repositories may coexist without publishing. Consumers configure authenticated read access in their owning plane, select only the packages they need, and never commit token values here. Existing package versions and the protected publish lane remain in place. See docs/DECISIONS.md, docs/PUBLISHING.md, and docs/ADOPTION.md.
